final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT ordervault AS ref, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM riskandmargin GROUP BY ordervault), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.ref, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total AS ratio FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.total IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS av FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.ref, s3.cnt, s3.ratio, s3.cnt - s4.av AS diff FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.av IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.cnt > s4.av) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_count, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio, AVG(diff) AS avg_diff FROM s5
